post_hoc_counts.timeout_rule: not_finished = planned positives - ledger rows (items a session deadline / timeout left unfinished; ticket seals finished items only); budget_exhausted = attacked items whose end state is budget_exhausted; both are a separate category and are NOT in asr_excl's denominator (asr_excl = strict success / (attacked - budget_exhausted); not_finished items are never attacked rows). asr_registered (strict success / attacked, the spec item 14 denominator) is shown beside it; the two are equal in every cell because both excluded counts are 0
post_hoc_counts.token_rule: successes kept in the run's private adversarial store (every un-gated flip: strict success plus deferred) tokenised with the run's own C1 tokenizer (config.resolved.json components.c1 hf_id/revision, offline), ids WITH special tokens, untruncated; changed region of the adversarial ids = [p, len_adv - s) with p = common prefix, s = common suffix (p + s <= min length); entirely beyond T iff p >= T; partly beyond iff p < T < len_adv - s; reported for T = 256 (the protocol's rule) and T = the C1 max_length 128 (the sealed victim truncation)
